quotes.text: We had a great time on our 4hr trip with Captain Robert! We fished offshore on an artificial reef and caught a bunch of pinfish, bluefish, and a couple black bass and flounder. From there we headed inshore to target some flounder and landed a 20” flounder to take home! Captain Robert was a great navigator showing us the best places to get a bite and gave us great instruction on how to catch the targeted species. A tough bite today but we had a blast! We look forward to fishing with Captain Robert again the next time we come back to the area!

Tama C.12 months agoWent with my 2 little boys on the fish finder III and I ended up sick and the captian still made sure my boys had an amazing time and helped out even more then he needed to because I couldn't. Such a great experience. The charter was easy to find, easy to book, talked about what we wanted to catch and the boys caught everything they were hoping for! I highly suggest going!!

Captain Robert was the best! We had to reschedule our first trip due to weather, but he was very professional and explained all our options. Captain Robert was patient with our 8 year old, and he landed 4 sharks in the first hour! Unfortunately we learned our kid gets sea sick, but Captain Robert handled it with ease and let us shorten the trip! We had a blast! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Ginny R.1 year agoAMAZING! Caption Robert was the best!!!We had a blast during our entire charter. We caught several beautiful Spadefish, Sea bass and a couple aggressive sharks. Hands done the best charter we’ve had in years. When we are back in the area we will be booking with Caption Robert and Fish Finder Fishing Charters for sure! Highly recommended!

Great experience fishing with Capt Dave on the fish finder 2! We took our boys (13, 12, & 8) on a 4 hour near shore fishing trip. Non stop catching fish and sharks! The boys had a blast and Capt Dave couldn’t have been a better host teaching the boys about their catch’s. Highly recommend if you’re in the area. We will definitely be back!

Brandy H.1 year agoIf I could give 100 ⭐️ I absolutely would would! Captain Robert is the best! Made my very first fishing adventure one I’ll never forget! He put us right on the fish. He definitely knows what he is doing and has a great personality to top it off! I will definitely come back!!! Highly recommended!!
